{{Top}}
An '''electrical storm''' was a weather phenomenon which could occur on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]],<ref name="The Planet of Twilight">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20020905twilight|text=The Planet of Twilight}}</ref> [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]],<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> and [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]].<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Near the top of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City's]] main dome, several [[Static discharge tower/Legends|static discharge towers]] were placed which helped secure the [[City/Legends|city]] during electrical storms.<ref name="SWCL" /> The electrical storms on Nam Chorios were in fact [[Force storm (weather)|Force storms]] generated by the use of [[The Force/Legends|The Force]].<ref name="The Planet of Twilight" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Empire 29">[[Empire 29|''Empire'' 29]]</ref> the moisture that was left in the atmosphere of Jabiim had become terminally polluted, causing sporadic storms of violent electricity, which further hampered the use of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles, such as [[2-M Saber-class repulsor tank/Legends|2-M Saber-class repulsor tank]] and [[T2-B Repulsor Tank/Legends|T2-B repulsor tank]].<ref name="EAWGG" />
